threads.body: The prefix is added under `addBootInfPrefix` in the single arg overload above, was just missing here. Didn't find an easy way to add a test for this.

replies.body:
The only place where this method is used is in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/539cba33668a58e563b4e568078b8cc204921306/instrumentation/spring/spring-boot-resources/javaagent/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/spring/resources/SpringBootServiceVersionDetector.java#L63 to read `META-INF/build-info.properties` which is at the root of the jar not under `BOOT-INF/classes`
Add 
```
springBoot {
	buildInfo()
}
```
to generate it.
